text:
My dear feather-eyed one!
My shackled little lookout lock!
My enchanting anemone
how you have abandoned me
and now I must weep for you.

White anemone
little April
distant springing water of my heart
fifteenth little key of my grief.
Farewell, you go into spring green!

translation.title: My Dear Feather-Eyed One!
